issues.issue: All operating expenses (99.8% of business-type spending) are in 'other' because the list has no airport/transportation function. Defensible since no category fits, but the user may want a convention for airports.

Capital grants printed below 'Change in Net Position Before Capital Grants' are recorded as other_financing, not federal grants receipts. This follows the housing-authority capital-contribution rule and is defensible, but it leaves the largest inflow of the year out of receipts.
